items.feature: SDK, package format, installation, update, uninstall and permissions

Roadmap A01 (2 points) is accepted for the bounded native SDK app/catalog path; A02/A03 and the full package lifecycle remain open

acceptance_criteria: Signed app is verified against selected trust source, launched under explicit least-privilege grants, updated/removed atomically and denied on malformed/tampered packages.

impacts.user: Installeren/bijwerken/verwijderen bepaalt appkeuze en herstelbaarheid.

items.recommended_next_step: Compare maintained embeddable engines and support cost; do not start a new browser engine.

impacts.user: Web en downloads zijn dagelijkse functies en compatibiliteitsingang.
impacts.security: Webcontent is onbetrouwbaar; engine patching/sandbox/TLS zijn kritieke grenzen.

Recommendation is audit guidance, not an adopted ADR

impacts.security: Lockscreen/history en notification actions kunnen privédata of rechten lekken.

No native accessibility event broker, braille/switch route or verified 200% zoom
blockers: Semantic APIs, assistive clients and human testing

items.recommended_next_step: Specify native accessibility tree/events and recruit representative testers before calling UI complete.

impacts.user: Ontbrekende assistieve bediening kan gebruikers volledige setup/recovery verhinderen.
impacts.security: Toegankelijkheidshelpers mogen grants/data niet onbedoeld uitbreiden.
impacts.accessibility: Rechtstreeks: native screenreader, focus, schaal, contrast, switch en reduced-motion.

items.feature: Unicode, shaping, RTL, IME, locales, translations and screen-reader language
limitations: UTF-8 data-path evidence does not establish text shaping, IME, RTL, locale formatting or translated system UI
blockers: Font fallback/shaping, input methods, localization and native accessibility language support
acceptance_criteria: Representative scripts, combining marks, RTL, IME, locale date/number/currency/timezone and screen-reader language switching work across setup, apps and recovery.
items.recommended_next_step: Create a script/locale test corpus and select maintained shaping/font/input components.

impacts.user: Taal-/scriptbeperkingen maken lezen, invoer en herstel ontoegankelijk.
impacts.security: Canonicalization/Unicode kunnen identifiers, paden en beleid beïnvloeden.
impacts.accessibility: Font/IME/RTL/locale en screenreader-language bepalen toegang.

items.feature: Native packet, IP/TCP/UDP service
limitations: Native bounded packet-stack proof is a component, not daily internet
Nieuwe TCP-reviewfixes hebben exacte-head CI doorlopen; componentbewijs blijft beperkt tot het geteste profiel
blockers: Dagelijkse internetconfiguratie, DNS, bestemmingsrechten en fysieke driverondersteuning blijven open
acceptance_criteria: Exact-head native cases cover real packet exchange, malformed packets, backpressure, client exit, timeout and reconnect on a named VM profile.
items.recommended_next_step: Bewaar het exacte-head CI-resultaat en voer het volledige native FR-N01–N04-profiel uit vóór een claim van dagelijks internet.

impacts.user: Internet, DNS en netwerkverandering zijn nodig voor browser en connected workflows.
impacts.security: Aanvalsoppervlak, peeridentity, routewijziging en pakketparsers zijn relevant.
impacts.accessibility: Netwerkstatus, fouten en captive portals moeten leesbaar en bedienbaar zijn.

items.feature: Ethernet/Wi-Fi, DHCP, DNS, IPv4/IPv6, routing, VPN and diagnostics

Wi-Fi, captive portal, VPN/hotspot and offline/resume remain open
blockers: Native driver/config/resolver integration and physical support profile
acceptance_criteria: A named VM then physical profile obtains IPv4/IPv6 configuration, resolves names and recovers from link changes; malformed, timeout, captive portal and offline cases show truthful status.
items.recommended_next_step: Integrate one native Ethernet profile and resolver before broad Wi-Fi claims.

impacts.user: Internet, DNS en netwerkverandering zijn nodig voor browser en connected workflows.
impacts.security: Aanvalsoppervlak, peeridentity, routewijziging en pakketparsers zijn relevant.
impacts.accessibility: Netwerkstatus, fouten en captive portals moeten leesbaar en bedienbaar zijn.

items.feature: Authenticated TLS, certificate lifecycle and hybrid PQC transport
limitations: N02 is host/loopback transport research; native TLS/peer-authentication and release trust roots are not accepted
blockers: Native crypto/TLS port, certificates/identity policy and exact-handshake runtime gates
acceptance_criteria: Native client authenticates the intended peer and rejects wrong identity, malformed/expired certificate, downgrade and unavailable PQC path without silent insecure fallback.
items.recommended_next_step: Port a maintained implementation only after native threat model, entropy and identity boundaries are frozen.

impacts.user: Zonder correcte rechten kan connected functionality onbruikbaar of onvoorspelbaar zijn.
impacts.security: Peer-, app- en destination-authority is een directe Security Floor boundary.
impacts.accessibility: Permission/identity prompts moeten begrijpelijk en keyboard/screenreader bruikbaar zijn.

items.feature: Per-app, per-destination network capabilities and revocation
limitations: Broker code/host cases do not prove kernel-enforced native egress restriction
Helper/socket/listener bypass paths remain release tests
blockers: Native process-to-network authority and traffic observation
acceptance_criteria: An app with no grant cannot send/receive; grant permits only declared peer; revocation blocks existing and new flows and helpers without changing unrelated grants.
items.recommended_next_step: Connect the broker to kernel-issued process capabilities and verify traffic at a controlled observation point.

impacts.user: Zonder correcte rechten kan connected functionality onbruikbaar of onvoorspelbaar zijn.
impacts.security: Peer-, app- en destination-authority is een directe Security Floor boundary.
impacts.accessibility: Permission/identity prompts moeten begrijpelijk en keyboard/screenreader bruikbaar zijn.

items.feature: NAS roles, identity pairing, encrypted sync, conflict handling and provider adapter
limitations: Host Node service and simulated UI are not native client/NAS roles
No accepted end-to-end keys, auto-resume, multi-client conflict resolution or provider ciphertext adapter
blockers: Native network, encrypted object storage, key recovery and persistence
acceptance_criteria: Two native clients pair by verified identity, sync opaque encrypted objects across offline/reconnect, resolve conflicts, enforce admin quota/revoke/delete and restore locally without provider key escrow.
items.recommended_next_step: Integrate client-side encryption and native pairing only after key and peer contracts pass threat review.

impacts.user: NAScontinuïteit beïnvloedt eigen data, sync en meerdere apparaten.
impacts.security: Key secrecy, peer identity, stale sessions, admin delete en rollback staan centraal.
impacts.accessibility: Pairing, status, conflict en herstel mogen geen technische expertise vereisen.

items.feature: Security Floor, app sandbox, secrets, privacy dashboard and independent audit
limitations: Kernel primitives and entropy have scoped native evidence
End-to-end app permissions, secret isolation, indicators, audit log and complete LP suite are open
blockers: B02, trusted distribution, network/file capability enforcement and external human security review
acceptance_criteria: Applicable LP scenarios run on one native image; privacy education can be disabled without rights changes; no app receives undeclared files, keys, listeners or network; external review findings are resolved.
items.recommended_next_step: Prioritize deny-by-default native permission enforcement and independent threat-model review.

impacts.user: Gebruiker moet gevolgen van toestemming, opslag en herstel begrijpen.
impacts.security: Rechtstreeks: isolatie, secrets, authenticity, revoke en privacycontract.
impacts.accessibility: Consent/security feedback moet duidelijk zijn zonder popupmoeheid of informatie alleen via kleur.

items.feature: Signed update, rollback protection, repair and recovery environment
limitations: Signed update gate has native scoped proof
No consumer installer, complete recovery environment, production trust/rotation chain or final image validation
blockers: Integrate updater with persistent data, boot verification, recovery and authorized release keys
acceptance_criteria: On exact release image, valid signed update commits atomically; tampering/downgrade fails; interruption at every write stage reaches a documented bootable recovery without user-data loss.
items.recommended_next_step: Test update/recovery as a combined cold-boot workflow, not a component gate.

impacts.user: Update- of recoveryfout kan apparaatstart/data-toegang blokkeren.
impacts.security: Authenticity, rollback en atomicity beschermen de trust chain.
impacts.accessibility: Update-, fout- en recoveryflow moet hulptechnologie behouden.

items.feature: Independent backup, verification, restore browsing and export
limitations: Snapshots/revisions and NAS sync are not an independent verified backup/restore product
blockers: Backup format, independent destination, integrity verification and restore UI/API
acceptance_criteria: Create an independent backup, verify it, restore selected objects and full data into a clean image, and export documented formats after source corruption/loss.
items.recommended_next_step: Define independent backup semantics and tested restore workflow before relying on sync or snapshots.

impacts.user: Zonder onafhankelijke restore kan dataverlies permanent zijn.
impacts.security: Backup moet confidentiality, integrity en sleutelgrenzen behouden.
impacts.accessibility: Restore browsing/selectie/voortgang moeten toegankelijk zijn.

items.feature: ACPI, suspend/resume, battery, thermal policy and power lifecycle
limitations: ACPI/RTC probes do not prove laptop suspend, battery, thermals or reliable resume
No physical power-cycle/sleep evidence
blockers: Physical device profile and coordinated device/session restore
acceptance_criteria: Repeated sleep/wake, lid, battery/thermal transitions and shutdown on named hardware preserve saved data, device state and revoked rights.
items.recommended_next_step: Keep VM shutdown evidence scoped; select physical hardware before promising laptop power behavior.

impacts.user: Slaap/wek/batterij beïnvloeden draagbaar dagelijks gebruik en werkbehoud.
impacts.security: Suspend/resume kan oude rechten, sleutels of apparaatstate heractiveren.
impacts.accessibility: Power/brightness/status moet zonder visuele signalen alleen toegankelijk zijn.

items.feature: Local model download, inference, context grants and resource control
limitations: P2 assistant is deterministic simulated response; no native inference runtime or accepted model
No demonstrated device-only network denial/model resource profile
blockers: Model/runtime feasibility, parser/license review, native broker and target hardware
acceptance_criteria: A selected real model answers novel tasks locally on named hardware; exact selected context only is available; network/helper attempts are denied; cancel, low-memory and missing-model cases are truthful.
items.recommended_next_step: Run the smallest local inference feasibility experiment with license/resource measurements and no network capability.

impacts.user: Optionele assistentie kan geselecteerde taken versnellen, maar ontbreken mag basiswerk niet blokkeren.
impacts.security: Modelparser, context leakage, network helper path en action broker zijn risicogebieden.
impacts.accessibility: AI-invoer/uitvoer, annuleren en status moeten screenreader/keyboard bruikbaar zijn.

items.feature: Q0 simulator, Q1 OS integration and physical QPU boundary
evidence: docs/verification/L02-ACCEPTANCE.md: accepted on source 433bab9feab74473517eb8d44f2fb4475848e0cf; integrated in main at 7fb8c722fc853692251e26fcdcea0ed86954ef15
limitations: The bounded native L02 QSIM job service has historical QEMU acceptance; this is not a fresh run on audit commit 380111b68688c981eec6abb8fab29174a29f5601
No physical QPU, quantum speedup, PQC proof or cloud fallback evidence
blockers: Integrated L02 regression and full FR-L04 acceptance remain open; physical QPU evidence is separate
acceptance_criteria: The integrated release image repeats L02's documented local job, reference vectors, cancellation, quota and cleanup; distinguish the historical native OS port, the integrated regression and any physical QPU result.
items.recommended_next_step: Repeat the L02 native gate on the integrated release image and keep FR-L04 open until it passes; assess physical QPU scope separately.

impacts.user: Experimentele differentiator; geen vereiste voor gewone desktopfunctie.
impacts.security: Quantum/PQC-claims kunnen cryptografisch vertrouwen verkeerd voorstellen.
impacts.accessibility: Jobbediening en meetresultaten moeten toegankelijk zijn als functie wordt aangeboden.

items.feature: Windows/macOS/Linux migration, filesystem and document-format compatibility
limitations: No accepted migration/import/export matrix or compatibility runtime
Opening one fixture cannot establish round-trip fidelity or app/game compatibility
blockers: Format inventory, maintained parsers, licensing, fidelity tests and fallback/export workflow
acceptance_criteria: Named real-world files and migration fixtures import/export with per-feature fidelity assertions; NTFS/exFAT/ext4/SMB/NFS and app-compatibility support are explicitly scoped.
items.recommended_next_step: Choose a small user-prioritized format/migration set and preserve loss-reporting/export paths.

impacts.user: Migratie/export bepalen of gebruikers hun data en workflows kunnen behouden.
impacts.security: Parser-, macro-, filesystem- en compatibility layers vergroten trust boundary.
impacts.accessibility: Formaatverlies en migratievoortgang moeten begrijpelijk worden gemeld.

items.feature: Calculator, editor, image/PDF, archive, screenshot, help and diagnostics
limitations: A small native editor/calculator/image decode subset exists
PDF, archive, screenshot, logs/diagnostics/help and consumer-ready features are not accepted
blockers: SDK/UI toolkit, storage and format-specific services
acceptance_criteria: Each included utility performs its real task on the release image and is usable with keyboard, errors, large/corrupt files and explicit grants.
items.recommended_next_step: Define the minimum utility slate for experimental desktop and assign one native acceptance case per tool.

impacts.user: Ontbrekende basisgereedschappen blokkeren alledaagse taken.
impacts.security: Elke tool heeft eigen input/parser/data permission attack surface.
impacts.accessibility: Apps moeten dezelfde native accessibility APIs ondersteunen.

items.feature: Distinctive, coherent and accessible product design system
limitations: Materiaal/quiet-futurism design is selected and browser prototype rendered
No native end-to-end design-system consistency or human evaluation; prototype is not OS UI proof
blockers: Native typography, shaping, accessible component states and integrated first-party apps
acceptance_criteria: Native setup, desktop, settings, apps and recovery share tested tokens/states at supported sizes/scales; representative users complete eight-hour-quality task scenarios with reduced-motion and focus support.
items.recommended_next_step: Port design tokens to native components only after render/text/accessibility primitives are chosen.

impacts.user: Samenhang en herkenbaarheid beïnvloeden gebruiksgemak maar zijn niet bewezen door screenshots.
impacts.security: UI mag privacystatus niet misleidend tonen of security choices verbergen.
impacts.accessibility: Rechtstreeks: contrast, motion, focus, schaal en semantiek zijn releasekwaliteit.

items.feature: Complete integrated test release, physical/human validation and reproducibility
evidence: exact-head CI run 41535553113 completed successfully (geen releasevalidatie)
limitations: Separate component/VM proofs do not constitute the final image
No physical profile, human usability study, independent external audit or full release-validation package
blockers: Many FR rows open; no authorized physical target or human/external review evidence
acceptance_criteria: All 62 required FR rows pass on the hash-bound final image at their prescribed N/D/V/T/P/H/A/X levels; no blocker remains; another clean environment can reproduce the package.
items.recommended_next_step: Hervat de bestaande geïntegreerde releasequeue vanaf de groene exacte-head CI; houd niet-uitgevoerde externe gates expliciet open.

impacts.user: Zonder reproduceerbare releases/support kan gebruiker niet veilig installeren of onderhouden.
impacts.security: Patchbeheer, ondertekenaarsbeheer, herkomst en incidentrespons zijn essentieel.
impacts.accessibility: Uitgave, installatie, documentatie en ondersteuning moeten ook toegankelijk zijn.
